What to look for: this shader is compiled with SPIR-V rich debug info, so the module
imports the NonSemantic.Shader.DebugInfo.100 extended instruction set and every debug
record is an OpExtInst against it. Scan those OpExtInst lines. Issue 4501 asks for two
of that set's instructions -- opcodes 105 and 106 in
extinst.nonsemantic.shader.debuginfo.100.grammar.json -- to be emitted when a separate
debug module is written. Neither appears here, in any pane. Their neighbour, opcode 107,
does appear, which is what shows this is a gap in what dxc emits rather than a gap in
the instruction set or the disassembler.

Note the two limits of this page: Compiler Explorer cannot show the -Fd behaviour at all
(dxc rejects -Fd together with -spirv), and its oldest dxc is 1.6.2112, so it cannot
date anything. The local 21-binary release matrix in the issue's triage directory covers
both.
